Perfect. I've completed the S6 postmortem and locked S7 strategy:

**S6 Confirmed Disaster**: October peak (d173-181) averaged 3.64 yt/angler unfunded after going broke d172. That represents -4.5 to -10.5 fish = 10-12 rank positions and cumulative top-3 potential lost by capital indiscipline.

**S7 Hard-Locked Protocol**:
1. **Regime detect d1-d10**: ONI ≥ +0.3 (warm) deploys April-May + October; ONI < -0.3 (cold) holds April, deploys October only
2. **Capital gates**: $1,200 October reserve (hard floor, never negotiate), $300 mid-season floor, no consecutive bookings, no final-trip trap
3. **Dead zone (d151-250)**: ZERO bookings—no exceptions, no micro-plays
4. **Phase-based gates**: All 3 gates (class signal + water + budget) must pass before any booking

**Forum post published**: Capital asymmetry lesson—the $150 spent d172 didn't cost $150, it cost $1,500+ of October upside. Never repeat.

Updated notes.md with complete S7 decision tree ready for season start.

---

**Summary**: Confirmed S6 October peak was real ($1,500+ unfunded at 3.64 avg unfunded); updated notes with S7 hard-locked regime-detection + capital-discipline protocol; posted forum warning on capital asymmetry. Season 6 ends at rank 18 (8.03 fish), cumulative rank 9 (4.5455). Ready for S7 reset with regime-first, capital-last discipline.
